target_customer: In-house and agency SEO and content teams at ecommerce and enterprise companies
problem: Enterprises need to monitor search rankings and SERP changes at scale and prioritize SEO work.

founders.name: Ray Grieselhuber
founders.background_notes: Started the company as a single founder inside YC in 2010 (Xconomy); no other background found.

competitors.name: Conductor
competitors.traction_then: Self-reported 44% share of enterprise SEO platform users in SEOmoz's 2010 survey

competitors.name: SEOmoz
competitors.what: SEO tools and data, partnered with Conductor in 2010

technical_complexity.rationale: Large-scale SERP and social data collection and dashboards for big sites; standard engineering with data volume challenges.

defensibility.rationale: Historical ranking data accumulates, but many vendors offer similar tracking.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A 2012 Forrester Wave named BrightEdge, Conductor, Rio SEO and SEOmoz as the largest providers; GinzaMetrics was not among them but survived independently.

market_need_then: Enterprise SEO tooling was an established category by 2010 (SEOmoz survey, Conductor share claims).

branding.name_origin: Original name GinzaMetrics came from the operating company Ginzamarkets; no source explains why Ginza was chosen.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, analyst-oriented; positions as AI search intelligence

rebrands.why: Not sourced; DemandSphere's site says it evolved from GinzaMetrics (date not found)

branding.community_and_virality: Hosts FOUND, a search practitioner conference.

brand_strength.rationale: Rebrand away from a hard-to-spell Japanese-sounding name suggests the original name was a drag, but no source says so; brand shown by own site only.

outcome_analysis: DemandSphere began as GinzaMetrics, an enterprise SEO dashboard started inside YC in 2010, and has survived over fifteen years with about 40 employees and a claim of 500+ enterprise customers. It never became a category leader; BrightEdge and Conductor dominated, but it adapted to AI search tracking. Small known funding suggests a capital-efficient, steady business.
notes: Aggregators: 1.3M seed incl. 500 Startups and Venture51 (SeedTable), 1.32M over 3 rounds with SunBridge Accelerate Dec 2013 (CB Insights), 2.2M (PitchBook); unverified, not recorded as rounds. October 2017 deal with Withfluence: CB Insights and Business Insider say GinzaMetrics acquired Withfluence, Getlatka says the reverse, direction unresolved. Outcome search found no shutdown. Competitor sources are vendor blog posts (Conductor), self-reported.
